For consumer information purposes, the labels present on food items use the term % Daily Value (%DV), which is a less quan-
titative means to conveniently compare the nutritional value of various foods. It provides the relative contribution that a serving of
that food makes to daily vitamin A intake, assuming a reference intake. Unlike the RDA and UL, the %DV is not scaled to different
values for adults and children.
